shortDescription: Couplers, manifolds, fittings, gauges, gauge adaptors, and control valves for ToughTorq hydraulic systems.
longDescription: ToughTorq hydraulic connection components provide pressure-rated interfaces between pumps, hoses, tools, cylinders, tensioning systems, gauges, and multi-tool circuits. The range includes 700 bar quick couplers, ultra-high-pressure couplers, oil manifolds, hydraulic fittings, pressure gauges, gauge adaptors, and hydraulic control valves.
features: NPT and G-thread hydraulic fittings and adaptors

operatingRequirements.label: Pressure Matching
operatingRequirements.value: All components in a hydraulic circuit must be rated for the system working pressure

operatingRequirements.label: Connection Matching
operatingRequirements.value: Match NPT, NPTF, G-thread, metric thread, male/female interface, and flow requirement exactly

compatibility: Do not connect components with incompatible pressure ratings.
Thread type, size, gender, flow capacity, and sealing method must match the connected equipment.
Ultra-high-pressure couplers and fittings must be used only with appropriately rated ultra-high-pressure systems.

componentGroups.description: 700 bar quick-connect couplers for standard hydraulic tooling.
150 and 250 MPa couplers for bolt tensioning, hydraulic nuts, and ultra-high-pressure systems.
700 bar NPT 3/8-inch manifolds for distributing one pump output to multiple tools.
Elbows, tees, crosses, couplings, reducers, nipples, and adaptors for hydraulic system configuration.
Dual-scale pressure gauges with model-specific pressure ranges and connection threads.
Three-port adaptors for connecting gauges, tools, hoses, and quick couplers.
Needle, check, and manual valves for flow control and load-holding functions.
